findings.summary: The six-duty self-gate is still not wired into the engine default delivery path. deliver_self_gate_decision (decision_mcp.py:459), which runs decide(evidence), is exported but never invoked by any production code: the only registered MCP tool decision_deliver (decision_mcp.py:977) still routes through the M2 _deliver_dd path and accepts no evidence payload (schema params are line/decision/reason/target_kind/target_id). The goal_line graph (graphs/goal_line.py) has no six-duty orchestration, and the scheduler (daemon.py:1586) calls ignition.decide, not the self-gate decide. The spec's core behaviors — '线自判路径成引擎默认' and '自动履行六项取证义务 → 经 decision_deliver 投递' (item 1), plus '六项取证义务 = gate 必答字段，缺任一项 → 投递被拒' (item 2) — are therefore still unreachable in the engine; only the standalone selfgate library and its direct-call unit tests exercise the positive path.
